description: This file contains React hooks for managing conferencing app OAuth URLs and connection logic, including fetching OAuth URLs for Zoom and Office 365, and connecting non-OAuth apps like Google Meet.

methods.name: useGetZoomOauthAuthUrl
methods.description: Hook to fetch Zoom OAuth authentication URL with optional return URLs and team ID.

methods.name: useOffice365GetOauthAuthUrl
methods.description: Hook to fetch Office 365 OAuth authentication URL with optional return URLs and team ID.

methods.name: useConnectNonOauthApp
methods.description: Hook to connect non-OAuth conferencing apps like Google Meet, handling success and error callbacks.

methods.name: useConnect
methods.description: Main hook to initiate connection to specified conferencing app (Zoom, Office 365, Google Meet) based on app slug.
